Dholera Smart City Ground Report | India’s Future Smart City on Ground Reality
In this video, I share my ground-level visit and on-site observations of Dholera Smart City, India’s first and largest planned greenfield smart city.
This is not just presentations or brochures —
I personally visited Dholera and explored its real infrastructure development, including:
Wide planned roads & walkable footpaths
Zebra crossings, cycling tracks & plantation planning
Smart street lights, sensors & underground utilities
Artificial river / stormwater canal system
